result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is clipped — the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off and the card image is partially visible, indicating a horizontal scroll container that does not visually communicate scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator or partially reveal the card more intentionally with a fade/gradient edge to signal horizontal scrollability to the user.

issues.description: The notification dot on the top-right circular button (red dot) appears slightly off-center or misaligned relative to the button boundary.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the positioning of the notification badge to be consistently anchored to the top-right corner of the button using proper absolute positioning.
